aim: Find one winning formula, prove it, grow it - then build the next.
written_by: Written on the evening of 9 Oct 2026, after Aaron's decision, from the real broker figures and the real-price research; the nightly review keeps it up to date.

focus.name: Formula 1
focus.what: LIVE by Aaron's decision of 9 Oct. Trend & Breakout's minor currency pair trades (EURGBP, AUDJPY and similar) use real money, about £13 a trade (0.7% of the balance); its momentum continuation there, in fast and news markets, is the part its record backs and can earn the bigger top-opportunity size. The rest of Trend & Breakout stays on PAPER and still feeds the Momentum Runner.
focus.evidence: Its record: 38 real trades over 10 days, 8 days up and 2 down, +£156.31 after £29.89 of commission (+£4.11 a trade). Without its best day it is still +£81 over 25 trades.
focus.caution: Chosen by looking back, so it has to prove itself on new live trades: it is judged after 20 of them.
focus.source: Trend & Breakout's real trades, 17 Sep - 8 Oct (MetaTrader's figures, after commission)
